spells.description: Passive: Urgot's other Abilities mark the last champion hit for 5 seconds. Active: Urgot begins firing his chain gun at the closest enemy, prioritizing marked enemies. spells.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill, impaling the first champion hit, dealing physical damage and Slowing for seconds by 1% per 1% missing Health, up to %. On reaching Urgot, they are killed and nearby enemies are Feared for seconds.
